blocking_material_findings.title: Trailing-dot DOI resolver references bypass conservative unresolved-alias gate
blocking_material_findings.effect: A conservative unresolved alias in any ledger column or owned-account metadata is missed; exact full-helper main entry performs one simulated append and emits a verified receipt.
blocking_material_findings.mechanism: Host regex lookahead excludes a terminal hostname dot. The imported recognizer also ignores this short alias.
blocking_material_findings.required_action: Recognize resolver trailing-dot authority references and fail closed pending root identity review; rerun whole-helper normal/-O/-OO controls before adoption.
blocking_material_findings.claim_limit: No asserted actual duplicate, alias resolution, URI equivalence, or live-service outcome.

strongest_verified_result: All 156 inherited guard regressions and 56 of 82 new independent controls have expected results in each mode. The original bare/protocol-relative v4 gap is repaired. The remaining gap is one trailing-dot resolver-reference family.
